scope: Official CFA retrospective on the first nationwide knockout competition and broad football participation context.
limitations: Competition history supports organised competition/popularity context, not a direct annual rating.

observations.text_value: The first nationwide football championship using a primarily knockout format was staged in Qingdao in 1956 and became the predecessor of the Chinese FA Cup.
observations.definition_notes: Structural/context evidence; the observed fact is not itself a direct annual 1–10 rating.
